author: Hayley Dibdin
content: I will always use USB Events, they are so good with communication and keeping you in the loop so everything goes smoothly on the day of the event. I phoned them an hour before the event started asking them to add something else on the package (got let down by another company last min) and they answered so quick and gave me exactly what I wanted. The guys are so quick and efficient at setting up, and are always on time. Thanks again, will defo be using you again.
